in_sop.name: CALCTRANS_MAPPING_KERNEL
in_sop.description:
Mapping 'SCIENCE' - 'CALCTRANS_KERNEL_LIBRARY' [string with ext_number comma separated (int)] :
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[CALCTRANS_MAPPING_KERNEL] FITS BINTABLE values is provided.
 The FITS BINTABLE have to one column [KERNEL_LIBRARY_EXT]

in_sop.name: CHIP_EXTENSIONS
in_sop.description:
Flag that determines if image extensions are to be treated as independent
 science data to be fitted for independently or as CHIP specific subranges 
 of a single observation to be fitted for as a single combined spectrum.
 Value = TRUE implies to treat as CHIPS to be combined. Value = FALSE implies
 to treat as independent. [FALSE]

in_sop.name: HDR_AIR1
in_sop.description: FITS header keyword to read the airmass at the start of the exposure from the telluric and science header. The telluric header was copied to BEST_FIT_PARAMETERS by molecfit_model and read from there.

in_sop.name: HDR_AIR2
in_sop.description: FITS header keyword to read the airmass at the end of the exposure from the telluric and science header. The telluric header was copied to BEST_FIT_PARAMETERS by molecfit_model and read from there.

in_sop.name: HDR_EXP
in_sop.description: FITS header keyword to read the exposure time from telluric and science header. The telluric header was copied to BEST_FIT_PARAMETERS by molecfit_model and read from there.

in_sop.name: HDR_MJD
in_sop.description: FITS header keyword to read the Modified Julian Date at the START of the exposure from telluric and science header. The telluric header was copied to BEST_FIT_PARAMETERS by molecfit_model and read from there.

in_sop.name: MAPPING_ATMOSPHERIC
in_sop.description:
Mapping 'SCIENCE' - 'ATM_PARAMETERS' input [string with ext_number comma separated (int)] :
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[MAPPING_ATMOSPHERIC] FITS BINTABLE value is provided.
 The FITS BINTABLE have to one column [ATM_PARAMETERS_EXT]

in_sop.name: MAPPING_CONVOLVE
in_sop.description:
Mapping 'LBLRTM_RESULTS' - 'TELLURIC_CORR' output [string with ext_number comma separated (int)] :
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[MAPPING_CONVOLVE] FITS BINTABLE value is provided.
 The FITS BINTABLE have to one column [LBLRTM_RESULTS_EXT]

in_sop.name: SCALE_PWV
in_sop.description:
Value read from science file to scale the precipitable water vapor (PWV) of the telluric spectra.
 If set to 'auto', the mean value of TEL AMBI IWV START/END is read from the header of the input science file.
 If set to a user-provided numerical value, use this as the scale factor.
 If set to a FITS header keyword, read in the scale factor from the header of the input science file using this keyword.
 If set to 'none', perform no scaling.

in_sop.name: SGWL
in_sop.description: Savitzky-Golay filter smoothing window length in pixels

in_sop.name: SGWL_ASMAX
in_sop.description: Treat the Savitzky-Golay filter smoothing window length as a maximum length

in_sop.name: USE_DATA_EXTENSION_AS_DFLUX
in_sop.description:
Only valid if USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA=TRUE. The fits extension index that contains the
 errors of the science flux data (DFLUX). A value of 0 implies that there is no DFLUX

in_sop.name: USE_DATA_EXTENSION_AS_MASK
in_sop.description:
Only valid if USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA=TRUE. The fits extension index that contains the
 mask associated with the science flux data. A value of 0 implies that there is no mask data.

in_sop.name: USE_INPUT_KERNEL
in_sop.description: If TRUE, use the kernel library if it is provided.

in_sop.name: USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA
in_sop.description:
Value=TRUE implies that only the fits primary contains the input science flux data.
 Value=FALSE implies that the fits extensions also contains input science flux data.
